shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side; a clear walkway runs opposite the window. A woman in a green shirt sits in the screen-side window seat and proposes taking a holiday, a man in an orange shirt sits in the door-side window seat, a man in a white shirt sits in the screen-side walkway seat, and a woman in a blue shirt sits in the door-side walkway seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the glass door end, looking along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and both walkway-side seats and the presentation screen in frame.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt leaves his seat and exits the venue, while a woman in a green shirt suggests a sea trip.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt asks about taking a river route instead.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the walkway side, centered on the person at the screen-side window seat.

shots.content: A woman in a blue shirt objects to a short voyage, and a woman in a green shirt replies.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the conference table.
